name: EnergyAssistanceApplicationDesk
tagline: Low-income energy assistance from intake to credit applied – in one Power Apps component.
description: Utility hardship and bill-assistance desk: household-size income guidelines, required documents, an energy-burden benefit calculator with what-if, shut-off crisis triage with SLA, programme budget control and a Submitted → Credit applied decision pipeline with business rules, bulk actions, undo and Power Fx events. Works in canvas, model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Bill Credit, Arrears Forgiveness, Crisis Grant and Discount Rate programmes
What-if household size, income and programme
Allowed status transitions and required fields
controlType: standard (2 controls: EnergyAssistanceApplicationDesk data-set + EnergyAssistanceApplicationDeskPortal field control)
